title: Mary & James Sobieski, Baby on Tree Stump - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Mary Sobieski Gilhousen
James Louis Sobieski
description: A charming candid snapshot capturing an adult woman, identified as Mary Sobieski Gilhousen, steadying a chubby young boy, James Louis Sobieski, as he sits upright on a cut tree stump in a sunny backyard. The baby wears a dark buttoned playsuit with bare feet, looking curiously into the distance, while the woman wears a classic patterned polka-dot housedress. The setting features a residential house, leafy branches, and a picket fence in the background, reflecting mid-century American domestic warmth and routine.
